SEARCH
Module awtzero
Package awtzero.transforms

Class Scale

java.lang.Object
awtzero.transforms.Scale
public class Scale extends Object
Provides static methods for scaling Image and ImageWrapper objects using different quality algorithms provided by Image.getScaledInstance(int, int, int).

  • Method Details

    • scaleDefault

      public static Image scaleDefault(Image original, int width, int height)
      Scales an Image to the specified dimensions using the default scaling algorithm. This typically uses a moderately quick algorithm that produces reasonable quality.
      Parameters:
      original - The original Image to be scaled.
      width - The desired new width in pixels.
      height - The desired new height in pixels.
      Returns:
      A new scaled Image object.
      See Also:
      • Image.SCALE_DEFAULT

    • scaleDefault

      public static ImageWrapper scaleDefault(ImageWrapper original, int width, int height)
      Scales an ImageWrapper's internal image using the default scaling algorithm.
      Parameters:
      original - The original ImageWrapper containing the image to be scaled.
      width - The desired new width in pixels.
      height - The desired new height in pixels.
      Returns:
      A new ImageWrapper containing the scaled image.

    • scaleFast

      public static Image scaleFast(Image original, int width, int height)
      Scales an Image to the specified dimensions using an algorithm optimized for speed. The image quality may be compromised for faster processing.
      Parameters:
      original - The original Image to be scaled.
      width - The desired new width in pixels.
      height - The desired new height in pixels.
      Returns:
      A new scaled Image object.

    • scaleSmooth

      public static Image scaleSmooth(Image original, int width, int height)
      Scales an Image to the specified dimensions using an algorithm optimized for smoothness (quality). This may be slower than other methods but generally produces the highest quality result.
      Parameters:
      original - The original Image to be scaled.
      width - The desired new width in pixels.
      height - The desired new height in pixels.
      Returns:
      A new scaled Image object.
      See Also:
